artifact.originalPrompt:
GENERATE A PROFESSIONAL 2D APARTMENT FLOOR PLAN.

PROJECT TYPE:
Multi-unit residential apartment building.

SITE:
35.00m width x 40.00m depth rectangular plot.

BUILDABLE ENVELOPE:
34.99m x 39.99m inside setbacks (front: 4.5mm, rear: 3mm, left: 3mm, right: 3mm).

ROAD:
North side road, north oriented upwards.

ORIENTATION:
0 degrees.

BUILDING:
4 floors (Ground + 3 (4 floors)).

CURRENT FLOOR:
TYPICAL RESIDENTIAL FLOOR.

UNITS ON THIS FLOOR:
2 distinct residential flats (FLAT 101, FLAT 102).

UNIT MIX:
1 x 2bhk, 1 x 3bhk

AREA REQUIREMENTS:
Optimized space utilization within the available net floor plate

COMMON CORE:
2 passenger lift(s), 1 main staircase(s), central common lobby and direct distribution corridors, vertical utility shafts / OTS ducts

AMENITIES:
children_play_area, visitor_parking, society_office

PARKING:
8 resident car parking spaces, 2 visitor parking spaces, 8 two-wheeler slots

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:
Balconies for all residential flats, utility/dry balcony adjacent to kitchens, excellent cross-ventilation.

ARCHITECTURAL ORGANIZATION (§4, §5, §7, §13, §14):
Use a realistic multi-unit apartment organization with clearly separated flats, a logical common circulation system, lift/stair core, balconies where requested, toilets, kitchen/service zones, shafts/ducts where required, and clear public/private/service zoning.

MANDATORY TYPOLOGY RULES:
- 2BHK Organization: Entry -> Foyer -> Living & Dining -> Kitchen -> Utility/Dry Balcony -> Master Bedroom (attached bathroom) -> Second Bedroom -> Common Bathroom -> Balcony.
- 3BHK Organization: Entry -> Foyer -> Living & Dining -> Kitchen -> Utility -> Master Suite (attached bathroom & balcony) -> Bedroom 2 (attached bathroom) -> Bedroom 3 -> Common Bathroom -> Main Balcony.
- 2BHK vs 3BHK Differentiation: A 3BHK unit must be drawn with a noticeably larger floor area and footprint than a 2BHK unit. Do not draw identical apartments with swapped labels.

EXACT COMPONENT QUANTITIES (§13, §14, §15):
- Exactly 2 distinct self-contained flats sharing this floor plate.
- Central core must clearly show: 2 lift(s), 1 staircase(s), and the central common lobby.

REFERENCE STYLE:
Use the supplied apartment floor-plan references as organizational and visual references. Do not copy their geometry. Do not copy their dimensions. Do not copy their labels. Do not reproduce their project-specific annotations.

DRAWING:
Top-down orthographic 2D architectural floor plan. Professional technical drafting appearance. Strong exterior walls. Clear internal walls. Consistent linework. Clear apartment boundaries. Clear doors. Clear windows. Clear staircases. Clear lifts. Readable room labels.

LANGUAGE:
English only. Latin alphabet only.

DO NOT:
Use Cyrillic. Use Russian. Use non-Latin text. Use gibberish. Use pseudo-text. Use random labels. Invent apartment names. Invent room requirements. Generate perspective. Generate a 3D view. Generate an exterior rendering. Generate artistic decoration. Generate random walls. Generate overlapping apartments. Generate floating walls. Generate rooms outside the buildable envelope.

COMPOSITION:
The floor plan should occupy most of the image and remain easy for a vision model to interpret.
